source.author: verg
source.text: Ipsae lacte domum referent distenta capellae ubera, nec magnos metuent armenta leones; ipsa tibi blandos fundent cunabula flores, occidet et serpens, et fallax herba veneni occidet, Assyrium volgo nascetur amomum.
source.text_original: Ipsae lacte domum referent distenta capellae / ubera, nec magnos metuent armenta leones; / ipsa tibi blandos fundent cunabula flores, / occidet et serpens, et fallax herba veneni / occidet, Assyrium volgo nascetur amomum.
source.text_english: The goats themselves will carry home udders swollen with milk, and the herds will not fear the great lions; the cradle itself will pour forth sweet flowers for you, and the serpent will die, and the deceitful herb of poison will die, while Assyrian amomum will spring up everywhere.
